subjects.subject: remediation-handoff
subjects.evidence: src/lib/org/playbook-brief.ts:5-27 (playbookMarkdown) is a deterministic, self-contained single artifact (title, dimension, summary, checklist steps, explicit 'Ask') meant to be pasted into a developer's own local coding agent Ascent cannot observe — realizes single-artifact-prompt-construction. src/lib/db/playbooks.ts:184-215 stampPlaybookApplications marks a playbook adopted ONLY when (a) it was IN THE loop lane's brief the agent actually saw, and (b) a real rescan verified the close ('the agent's claim is not the trigger — the verifier is') — a precise, well-anchored realization of evidence-based-auto-close that specifically guards the coincidental-close failure mode the golden path names as the subject's hardest problem.

subjects.subject: wizard-flows
subjects.evidence: Playbook authoring is a single prefillable form seeded from PLAYBOOK_TEMPLATES (src/lib/org/playbook-templates.ts:14-19) with no sequence of dependent decisions converging on one commit — the golden path itself names exactly this shape ('a form wearing pagination... if every step could be shown at once with no loss of meaning, show them at once') as the canonical non-wizard case. 'Steps' in this context names checklist items inside the generated artifact (playbook-brief.ts), not UI wizard steps — the matcher's why=["apply","steps","flows"] looks like a lexical collision on that word, not a real match.

subjects.subject: remediation-handoff
subjects.evidence: handoff/route.ts realizes handoff-tenancy-and-idempotence: requireOrgAccess + whole-request 403 on any foreign/unknown id (no existence oracle), PUBLIC_ORG refused, MAX_BATCH 50, only open->in_progress with skipped-and-why reported. Wave-3 item 8 closed the one gap: db/scans-recommendations.ts handoffRecommendations now does ONE membership-scoped read and per-row CAS (status+org in the WHERE) in one tx with events+audit, so a row moving open->done mid-request can no longer be silently reopened. Residual tension: the ownership predicate now has two spellings (getRecommendationOrgSlug and the batch read's join), both in the same module.

subjects.subject: browser-credential-boundary
subjects.evidence: src/lib/db/client.ts reads DATABASE_URL/DSQL config via plain process.env, never NEXT_PUBLIC_-prefixed, and src/lib/db/index.ts:4 imports "server-only" so a client-component import of the DB barrel fails the build by design (comment cites ADR 2026-08-28-server-only-boundary); env.ts documents the NEXT_PUBLIC_ split explicitly. Prisma/DSQL is reached exclusively server-side — there is no browser-held credential or RLS-style policy engine fronting this store (unlike Supabase, which is deliberately regime-one for auth only, per supabase/client.ts:1-4 and .env.example:145).
